decisions.statement: A filter that reads the same as the filter held redraws nothing.
A row is matched against its label and its detail and its note.
A row is identified apart while a filter is there.
A row is identified by the key its initiative is keyed by.
A row whose children carry colors counts those children by color after that.
A row whose children carry no color takes no count by color.
A row with a color sits under a scheme of this panel's own.
A color is drawn by a decoration answering that scheme rather than on the row.
A decoration answers nothing for a name under any other scheme.
Every row has a blank icon.
A row carries the kind that row is.
A menu is matched against the kind a row carries.
A row opening no document says in its tooltip that the row represents nothing declared.
A row opens the whole path that row has rather than a path composed here.
A tooltip says a row's path against the checkout rather than whole.

definition: the rows the editor asks for of the work tree and the color each row is drawn in
